description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating a navigation drawer pattern, including setup of drawer layout, toggle, handling selection, and fragment management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Activity that manages the navigation drawer, action bar, and content fragments.

classes.name: MainActivity$PlanetFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying details of selected planet, inflates layout with planet image and name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up drawer layout, toggle, list adapter, and default fragment.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu items based on drawer state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item clicks, including toggling drawer and performing web search.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Handles selection of navigation drawer items, replacing fragments accordingly.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Synchronizes toggle state after activity creation.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Passes configuration changes to the drawer toggle.
